title: Personas v1
description: `personas/<product>.json`, written by `eval personas discover` and the `evaluate` pipeline (dokimi.personas.generator): the user personas a model proposed for one product, read by `eval personas validate`, `eval questions generate --personas` and the pipeline. The generator checks that each persona has its six fields; a person may edit the file before it is used.

run_id.description: The envelope: the id of the run that saved this file (dokimi.artifacts.run_id). Absent from files saved before the envelope.

dokimi_version.description: The envelope: the dokimi version that saved this file. Absent from files saved before the envelope.

generated_at.description: UTC, ISO 8601 with a trailing Z.

id.description: lowercase_snake_case; questions name their persona by it.

skill_level.description: beginner, intermediate or advanced, as the prompt asks; not enforced.
